user.title: Add Philips SICP Display
user.description: Provide the connection details for the display. NOTE: The display must be turned on and connected to a network accessible by Home Assistant.

data_description.mac: The MAC address of the display, used to build the Wake-on-LAN magic packet so it can be woken while powered off.
data_description.broadcast_address: Leave at 255.255.255.255 when the display shares a subnet with Home Assistant. If it is on another subnet, the limited broadcast is never routed: enter an unused IP in the display's subnet (for example 192.168.45.250), bind that IP to ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff with a static ARP entry on your router, and allow UDP port 9 between the two subnets. See UNIFI_SETUP.md.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the display. Confirm the IP, monitor ID, and network reachability.
error.setup_error: Error during display setup or connection check: {error_detail}
error.invalid_monitor_id: Monitor ID must be a number between 1 and 255.
error.invalid_mac: MAC address must be six hexadecimal pairs separated by colons or dashes.
error.invalid_broadcast_address: Broadcast address must be a valid IPv4 address.
